info.title: Traefik Hub Developer Portal API
info.description:
The Developer Portal API provides endpoints for developers to discover APIs, manage applications,
create API keys, and subscribe to APIs with self-service capabilities.

This API is part of Traefik Hub API Gateway and runs within customer Kubernetes clusters.
Some features require connection to the Traefik Hub platform.

servers.description: Developer Portal API (relative to portal base URL)

get.description:
Retrieves the developer portal configuration, including available APIs, bundles,
plans, and user-specific subscriptions. This endpoint returns only APIs and bundles
that the authenticated user has access to based on their group memberships.
Retrieves the OpenAPI 3.0 specification for an API.
Retrieves the OpenAPI 3.0 specification for a specific version of an API.

Retrieves all applications owned by the authenticated user. Each application includes
its API keys and subscriptions.

post.description: Creates a new application for the authenticated user.

delete.description:
Deletes an application and all its associated API keys and subscriptions.
Only non-managed applications can be deleted. Users can only delete applications
they own.

put.description:
Updates application notes. Only non-managed applications can be updated.
Users can only update applications they own.

example.notes: Updated production notes with new contact info

delete.description:
Deletes an API key for an application.
Only non-managed applications can have API keys deleted.
Users can only delete API keys from applications they own.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: The title of the API key to delete.

get.description: Retrieves all API keys for an application. Users can only list API keys for applications they own.

post.description:
Creates a new API key for an application. The API key token is returned only once
at creation time and cannot be retrieved later. Only non-managed applications can
have API keys created.

Suspends or unsuspends an API key. Suspended keys cannot be used for authentication.
Only non-managed applications can have API keys suspended/unsuspended.
Users can only modify API keys from applications they own.

Creates or updates self-service subscriptions in batch. This endpoint allows users to
subscribe their applications to APIs with specific plans. The operation filter, rate limit,
and quota must exactly match the catalog item configuration for the selected plan.

If a subscription ID is provided, the subscription will be updated; otherwise, a new
subscription will be created.

This endpoint requires the self-service-subscription feature to be enabled.

limit.description: The number of requests per period used to calculate the regeneration rate. Traffic will converge to this rate over time by delaying requests when possible, and dropping them when throttling alone is insufficient.

period.description: The time unit used to express the rate. Combined with limit, it defines the rate at which request capacity regenerates (limit ÷ period).

limit.description: Limit is the maximum number of requests per sliding period.

include.description: name of the operation sets that are allowed to be called by the client.

isManaged.description: Whether the subscription is managed by administrators (read-only via API).

claims.description: Expression that validate claims in order to authorize the request.

value.description: Custom value for the API key. If not provided, a random value will be generated. This field is only accepted when the administrator has enabled user-defined API key values; otherwise, a 403 response will be returned.

token.description: The API key token (only shown once at creation).

suspend.description: True to suspend, false to unsuspend.
